root_cause: malignant decision threshold hardcoded to argmax (0.5) in eval harness and demo; B21 probabilities run systematically lower so argmax parked it in a benign-leaning corner of the ROC curve
verdict: V21 @ malignant thr 0.25 replaces V12 as champion - better on benchmark (+4.4pp) and on wild pool (+3.0pp), +7 cancers caught, 4 fewer errors overall
wild_199_note: CORRECTION: the earlier 45.7% (and the 48.2% harness figure) were measured with gate_thresh 0.50. At the DEMO-SHIPPED gate threshold of 0.30 the same weights score 49.2% (98/199) with 50/95 cancers caught and 48/104 benign right.

gate_threshold_joint_optimum.note: lowering the gate threshold gains wild films but costs benchmark normals; 0.30 is the joint optimum. 2-fold CV on wild alone prefers 0.05 (99/199) but costs 6 benchmark normals.

ensemble_result.verdict: probability averaging does NOT beat the best single specialist at matched cancer sensitivity - the four models share a bias from the same 2,736 training images, so averaging pulls toward the shared error

ood_detection_result.verdict: NO confidence signal detects wild-pool errors well; disagreement is INVERTED (films where all 4 models agree are MORE likely wrong - correlated error)
